name: Pizza
description: A homemade pizza recipe with a yeast-based crust, topped with spaghetti sauce, various meats, and mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Dissolve yeast in warm water with sugar. Let stand in a warm place for 10 minutes.
Measure flour and salt into a large bowl. Make a well and pour in the yeast mixture. Stir and add oil gradually, working the dough until thoroughly mixed.
Knead the dough, form into a ball, and let stand in a warm place for approximately 45 minutes.
Preheat oven to 400°F.
Roll out the dough on a floured pastry board to an even thickness. Transfer to a pizza pan or cookie sheet.
Cover with spaghetti sauce, meats, mushrooms, and other toppings. Finish with mozzarella cheese.
Bake for approximately 20 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.
Let stand for 3 to 5 minutes before cutting and serving.

_similar.name: Pizza Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty pizza-inspired casserole with pasta, pepperoni, and mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Melt margarine and sauté chopped onion until soft.
Add tomato sauce, mushrooms, oregano, and basil. Stir and remove from heat.
Cook pasta in boiling water with oil and salt for 8 to 10 minutes until tender but firm. Drain.
Combine cooked pasta with Parmesan cheese and 1 cup mozzarella cheese in a 3-quart casserole.
Scatter pepperoni slices over the pasta mixture.
Cover with the tomato-onion sauce and sprinkle with remaining mozzarella cheese.
Bake, uncovered, in a 350°F oven for 30 minutes.

_similar.keywords: pizza casserole, pasta bake, pepperoni, mozzarella cheese

_similar.name: Pizza Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty pizza casserole made with spaghetti, hamburger, pepperoni, and mozzarella cheese.
recipeIngredient: 1 tsp cooking oil or olive oil

recipeInstructions.text: Cook spaghetti as per package instructions and drain.
In a bowl, combine cooked spaghetti, margarine or butter, eggs, and Parmesan cheese.
Spread the spaghetti mixture in a greased 9x13 inch pan.
Brown hamburger and onion in a skillet and spoon over the spaghetti mixture.
Spread spaghetti sauce over the hamburger mixture and cover with mozzarella cheese.
Sprinkle with oregano and drizzle with oil.
Arrange pepperoni slices on top.
Bake in a preheated 350°F oven for 20 to 30 minutes.

_similar.name: Pizza Meatball
recipeIngredient: 12 oz frozen meatballs, thawed and cut in half

recipeInstructions.text: Place pizza crust in a pizza pan or on a baking sheet.
Sprinkle 1 cup of shredded mozzarella cheese over the crust.
Place meatballs on top of the cheese, cut side down.
Spread remaining pizza sauce over the meatballs.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese and Italian seasoning.
Bake in a 400°F oven for approximately 20 minutes, or until cheese is melted.
Cut into pizza wheels and serve.

_similar.name: Spaghetti Sauce
_similar.description: A rich and flavorful homemade spaghetti sauce made with tomato paste, tomato sauce, and ground beef, simmered for several hours.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all ingredients except ground beef in a large pot. Cook gently for at least 2 hours.
Sauté the ground beef until browned, drain off fat, and add to the sauce.
Continue cooking gently for another 2 hours.

_similar.keywords: spaghetti sauce, homemade tomato sauce, Italian sauce
